content:
cleo (product): Quick sync — we need a firm acceptance checklist for the new "cost-aware inference profiles" initiative before we fold into the roadmap handoff to sales. Items: SLAs, docs, support matrix, monitoring/alerts, pricing buckets. Who can own each?
jamie (eng-platform): I can take runtime SLA + monitoring. Proposal: SLOs = 99.9% availability; p95 latency <= 50ms, p99 <= 200ms for 512-token gen on Dedicated config. Fallback: auto-route to a cheaper quantized model if queueing > 80%.
suresh (eng-reliability): Agree on basic numbers. Need explicit error-budget and alert thresholds: error rate < 0.1% rolling 1h, and paging if error budget burn > 50% in 30m. Also require a runbook stub with fallback steps.
oliver (product-ops): Sales wants committed throughput tiers and clear contract language for Dedicated vs Hosted. Also need a support-response SLA (business hours vs 24/7).@tara (pricing) can you outline proposed buckets?
tara (pricing): Draft buckets: Dev (pay-as-you-go), Standard (monthly commit w/ burst), Enterprise (annual reserved + premium support). Sample calc snippet for docs:
```
// cost per 1K tokens (standard) = base_token_rate * 1000 + reserved_node_amortization
base_token_rate = $0.0004
reserved_node_amortization = reserved_monthly_cost / expected_monthly_tokens
```
We need usage profiles to pick sensible reserved pricing.
cleo (product): Docs and quickstarts?
jamie (eng-platform): I'll author the runtime behavior doc and SLA appendix (including fallback routing logic).
maria (devex): I'll own SDK samples, quickstarts, and the pricing calculator page. Will include the code snippet above and a small workbook.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2345: "runbook + alert rules for cost-aware profiles" assigned to suresh, jamie.
suresh (eng-reliability): I'll draft the runbook template and the initial PagerDuty escalation path.
cleo (product): OK — owners: SLA/monitoring = jamie+suresh; docs = jamie+maria; pricing = tara; sales contract language = oliver. Next deliverables: initial draft checklist by EOD Thursday, runbook skeleton by Monday. Anyone blocked?
tara (pricing): Need list of expected token distributions (short vs long) — cleo can you share customer sample set?
cleo (product): Yes, uploading anon prompts to the shared drive now and pinging sales for a usage report. Thanks all :thumbsup:
